summary: Transfer entropy between cloud area fraction and TOA albedo shows NO significant directional information flow at any lag (1-12 months, p>0.10 for all). This contrasts with A019 CCM result (p=0.020, converging). The discrepancy suggests cloud-albedo coupling is SYNCHRONOUS (same-month response) rather than lagged — CCM detects shared attractor manifold structure while TE requires sequential predictability. This is null for H001 via TE but does not refute H001: the CCM result remains valid, and synchronous coupling is physically reasonable (clouds respond within days to albedo perturbations, not months). Methodological finding: CCM is more sensitive than TE for detecting coupling in synchronously-driven Earth system variables.
